Package com.j3d.gen.guide

Class Anchor

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.gen.guide.Anchor
public class Anchor extends Object
Positioning bitmasks for GuideInfo and GuidePanelAdapter.

These are just quick positioning rather than having to do coordinate calculations yourself. Used in GuideInfo.addCompAt(GuidePanelAdapter, Component, int) and GuideInfo.addCompAt(GuidePanelAdapter, Component, int, int, int) since offsets might still be needed.

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole

  • Method Details

    • has

      public static boolean has(int value, int bit)
      Checks if a given combined anchor value contains a specific anchor bit. This is useful for determining if a particular direction or center is part of the specified positioning.
      Parameters:
      value - The combined anchor value (e.g., NORTH | EAST).
      bit - The specific anchor bit to check for (e.g., NORTH).
      Returns:
      true if the value contains the bit, false otherwise.

    • hasVertical

      public static boolean hasVertical(int value)
      Checks if the given combined anchor value includes either the NORTH or SOUTH anchor bits.
      Parameters:
      value - The combined anchor value.
      Returns:
      true if NORTH or SOUTH is present, false otherwise.

    • hasHorizontal

      public static boolean hasHorizontal(int value)
      Checks if the given combined anchor value includes either the EAST or WEST anchor bits.
      Parameters:
      value - The combined anchor value.
      Returns:
      true if EAST or WEST is present, false otherwise.
